connectionReference.description: Connection to Notion API for retrieving and updating tasks from Notion databases

queryDatabase.description: Query a Notion database for tasks

databaseId.description: The ID of your Notion tasks database

statusProperty.description: The name of the status property in your database

dueDateProperty.description: The name of the due date property in your database

priorityProperty.description: The name of the priority property in your database

setupInstructions: 2. Click 'New integration' and give it a name
3. Select the workspace where your tasks database exists
5. In your Notion database, click '...' → 'Add connections' → Select your integration
6. Copy the database ID from the URL (the 32-character string after your workspace name)
7. Enter the token and database ID in the connection settings
